title: Fewest Coins
description:
You have an unlimited supply of coins of several denominations. Find the smallest number of coins whose values add up to exactly the target amount. If the amount cannot be made, print -1. An amount of 0 needs 0 coins.

Input format
Line 1: n (the number of denominations) and the target amount.
Line 2: the n coin values.

Output format
One integer: the minimum number of coins, or -1.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 12. Each coin value is between 1 and 10000. 0 <= amount <= 10000.
hints: Always taking the largest coin that fits does not always give the fewest coins. Try denominations 1, 3, 4 with amount 6.
Let best[a] be the fewest coins needed to make amount a. To make a, the last coin was some denomination c, so best[a] = 1 + best[a - c] for the best choice of c.
Fill best[0..amount] in increasing order with best[0] = 0 and 'impossible' (a large value) elsewhere. If best[amount] is still impossible, print -1.

examples.explanation: Coins of value 2 can never add up to 3.
